subject.title: refactor(meeting-bot): extract browser meeting-bot core behind MeetingPlatformAdapter

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/meeting-runtime` become a supported public plugin API before a second meeting-platform adapter validates the contract?
rationale: The code can be reviewed mechanically, but deciding whether one implementation is sufficient to establish an 81-export external SDK stability commitment requires explicit product and API-owner intent.

options.title: Keep the surface internal
options.body: Land or retain the shared implementation behind a bundled-only internal facade, then publish a narrowed SDK when the Teams adapter validates the seams.

options.title: Approve the public SDK now
options.body: Explicitly accept the compatibility commitment, document its stability expectations, and require focused external-API compatibility tests plus live Meet proof before merge.

options.title: Defer the extraction
options.body: Pause this PR and combine the abstraction with the second adapter so both implementations shape the initial public contract.

recommendation.title: Keep the surface internal
recommendation.body: Land or retain the shared implementation behind a bundled-only internal facade, then publish a narrowed SDK when the Teams adapter validates the seams.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged history and this extraction make @steipete the strongest available owner for the intended meeting-runtime boundary.
